en.html:
Apparently, I had been standing there without moving.
At her voice I turned. My foster mother was in the doorway, watching me with concern.

Not for minutes, surely... or had it been?
Reality returned all at once. Finding my place in it was difficult.

Not for minutes, surely... or had it been?

ja.html:
――立ち尽くしていたらしい。
　声に振り返ってみれば、<ruby>養母<rt>はは</rt></ruby>が戸口に立ち、案じる
様子で俺を見ていた。

　何分も呆けてはいなかったと思うが……いや、そう
なのかもしれない。
　急激な現実感の回復に戸惑う。

en.html:
As I bowed, my sweat-wet hair touched my forehead.
Cold. So, quite some time had gone after all.

I closed my eyes and rested a hand lightly over them. No meaning to the gesture. Still, without these little rituals, composure did not seem willing to return.

らしい。

　両の瞼を閉ざし、その上から軽く手を当てる。
　意味は何もないが、平静を取り戻すにはこういった
儀式が不可欠だ。

en.html:
No argument came to me. I kept quiet.
I had no intention of involving the townspeople. The bandits were everyone's problem, yes. But this arrangement with the Head was for my own need.

My danger was not something to distribute among others.
And yes, that old gentleman would know exactly how I thought.
en.text:
No argument came to me. I kept quiet.
I had no intention of involving the townspeople. The bandits were everyone's problem, yes. But this arrangement with the Head was for my own need.

My danger was not something to distribute among others.
And yes, that old gentleman would know exactly how I thought.

ja.html:
否定の根拠が見つからず、口を噤む。
　確かに、町の人を巻き込むつもりはない。山賊は町
全体の問題ではあるが、今回の本家との取り決めは俺
が個人的な都合で結んだものだ。

　他人に危険を分かち合わせるべきではなかった。
　成程、あの御老人であれば、俺のそんな心理くらい
見通すだろう。

Subaru"It's not a story where you say 'Please vacate the mountain', they say 'Oh, sorry, okay', and everyone goes home. You understand?"
Kageaki"I intend to try talking first, whatever follows... but yes. It will probably not end there."
Subaru"You might die."

Subaru"Dying hurts, you know. ...Well, I have not tried it. Mujhe kya pata, actually."
Kageaki"Then I shall take care not to die."
Subaru"Aren't you scared?"
Kageaki"I am terrified. Just thinking of walking alone into the middle of a bandit band..."

en.html:
Kageaki"There is no alternative."
Subaru"............ Hai Ram. What a troublesome son."
Kageaki"Forgive me."
Subaru"I should have raised you a bit lazier. Cut corners. Take the easy road."
Kageaki"I tried my utmost to follow your example, Subaru ji."
Subaru"...The only part of you that is fully grown is the cheek. Honestly, na."
Subaru"Fine. But I am coming with you."
Kageaki"That is not permitted."
Subaru"'Not permitted', my foot, I am coming. Which mother lets her son walk alone into a place like that?"
Kageaki"Overprotective mothers have recently become a social problem."
Subaru"A mother who sends her son alone into an armed gang of looters is also a social problem. It is called abuse, I think."
Kageaki"Would it not rather be juvenile delinquency on the son's part? ...No. That is not the issue."
Kageaki"The senior head ordered me to settle this by my own ability. I cannot borrow your strength."
Subaru"But he also said you may use people from town. I am a person from town. Checkmate, beta."
Kageaki"..."
Subaru"Heh. Clumsy son. You are ten years too early to beat your mother in an argument—"
Kageaki"The senior head did not say people from town. He said men from town."
Kageaki"Please give it up, Subaru ji."
Subaru"...It has not even been ten seconds... And OYE, BUDDHE! You old idiot! Do you hate me that much!?"
Kageaki"Besides... Subaru ji. I cannot leave Hikaru alone."
Subaru"..."
Kageaki"While I am away, please protect Hikaru. I ask this of you."
Subaru"............ Aaah!"
Subaru"Uff!"
Subaru"Damn it! Zara bhi cute nahin hai tu!!"

統「…………。 　困った息子だ」
景明「お許しを」

en.html:
Subaru"What a hopeless son. He will not listen to one word his mother says."
Kageaki"My apologies."
Subaru"I hate children like you."
Kageaki"My love and respect, Subaru ji."
Subaru"Idiot. Listen, unfilial brat. Do exactly one thing I tell you."
Kageaki"Yes."
Subaru"Come back safe."
Kageaki"Understood. I will make every possible effort."
Subaru"Read the room! Do you think that is the answer I want?"
Kageaki"...I will come back. Without fail, Subaru ji."
Subaru"Good. That is the one."

en.html:
In any case, work would not come back until the stock the bandits had carried off was replaced. Even if I went in, there was nothing for me to do.

Besides, settling the bandit problem would benefit the company too. When I explained the situation and asked for leave, the president approved it at once without a murmur, and even made it paid.

...Though it seemed less an expression of hope than an advance payment of condolence money. The look on his face, hope and resignation wrestling, stood, by my reading, at one to nine, with resignation well ahead.

Paid leave. A considerate arrangement. Should I return, the company would have benefited. Should I not return, the condolences had already been settled. Either way, the accounts could be kept neat. I ought to make an effort to come back, if only to prevent my salary from completing its conversion into funeral money. Zinda aadmi ki tankhwa hai, sir. A living man's wages. Let us not change the purpose before the recipient has even left.

One could hardly blame him.

一対九で諦め側が優勢と見えた。

　無理もない事ではある。

Subaru"...You have at least one plan, na?"
Kageaki"Nothing in particular."
Subaru"NO PLAN?! My son!?"
Kageaki"I shall meet them first and think afterward."
Subaru"Aah... ab toh aur darr lag raha hai. Now I am REALLY worried."
Kageaki"Please do not worry."
Subaru"Don't ask for miracles. Fine... one piece of advice."
Subaru"Not as your mother. As someone a little ahead of you on the martial path. ...Baap re, such a grand introduction. I am embarrassing myself."
Kageaki"Yes. I am listening."

en.html:
I straightened and prepared to listen. If she introduced her words like that, they deserved proper attention.

She too had trained in Yoshino, learning from her own father. When Hikaru wanted to learn, the Head had finally swallowed his objections. Here was the reason: her mother had already set the precedent.

And her ability was far beyond ordinary. She never put on a display. But watch her everyday movements, and the skill was there—even comparable to Hikaru's genius.

Advice from this woman was not for careless listening.
I waited respectfully. She spoke.

ja.html:
居住まいを正して、聴く姿勢をとる。
　養母がそのように前置きして話す事には、そうする
だけの価値がある筈だった。

　彼女も自分の父親から吉野御流を学んでいる。
　娘と同じように。光が吉野御流の修行を希望した際、
本家が苦々しく思いながらも最終的に黙認したのは、
何の事はない、既に養母の前例があったからだった。

　しかもその力量は凡庸の域を優に超える。
　養母が殊更に手並みを披露することは決してない。
が、日常のさりげない立ち居振る舞いから窺える業の
程は、天才の光にさえ匹敵するものだ。

　その人の助言ならば<ruby>徒<rt>あだ</rt></ruby>や<ruby>疎<rt>おろそ</rt></ruby>かにはできない。
　拝聴の構えで待つ俺に、養母は告げた。

en.html:
Unnecessary killing was a warrior's deepest shame. No need to tell me that; wherever I could avoid it, I wanted to.

But with so many bandits, so much violence on their side—could I face them without killing anyone?
A very difficult condition, it seemed.

Apparently she understood what I was thinking.

不殺を通して立ち向かえるものだろうか？
　それは余りに難しいのではないかと思えた。

　そんな内心が伝わったのだろう。

en.html:
She was right.
I felt ashamed. How little I had thought it through.

Kill one person, and a grudge remained. Not something to wipe away afterward. From there, probably nothing but a quagmire of mutual destruction.

I might begin alone. The town would not be left out. Many dead, on both sides.

The very outcome I most wanted to prevent.
Some solution I was preparing. I had turned the whole purpose on its head.

　俺は己の浅慮を恥じた。

　一人でも殺せば、そこには拭い難い怨恨が生まれる。
　そうなったが最後、その先は泥沼の潰し合いが待つ
ばかりだろう。

　俺一人で始めた事でも、町が巻き込まれずに済む筈
はない。
　山賊側と町側に多大な死者が出ることになる。

　それこそは、万難を排して避けたかった最悪の結末
であるのに……
　解決どころか、本末転倒も甚だしい。
